title: Avenqo
summary: Avenqo is a modular enterprise AI SaaS platform with a shared, tenant-isolated Python AI engine, whose synthetic-data module includes placeholder CTGAN/TVAE/Gaussian Copula model stubs written as native Keras substitutes because SDV is not yet installed. The stub docstrings explicitly reference sdv.single_table.CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer as the intended reference implementation to swap in later.
needs: Confirm whether sdv is ever actually installed/called elsewhere in the repo; current evidence shows only docstring references to a not-yet-integrated dependency.
